design_concept: Tactical Minimalism - A highly professional, data-dense, dark-themed CRM tailored for course enrollment management. Prioritizes legibility, structured hierarchy, and efficiency without generic 'Bootstrap' aesthetics.

typography.secondary_font_usage: Body text, Tables, Forms, Supporting text
typography.install_command: Use Google Fonts for Outfit and Manrope

colors.strategy: Deep Slate Base with High-Contrast Action Accents

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders (border-slate-800). No soft glowing dropshadows. Use inner borders to separate nested cards.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with subtle opacity (bg-slate-900/50). Avoid 'glassmorphism' for clinical/data apps to maintain clear data reading.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg (8px) for cards/modals, rounded-md (6px) for buttons/inputs, rounded-full for avatars/badges.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) over the main background to reduce digital flatness.

layouts.main_structure: Left Sidebar (w-64 on desktop, hidden on mobile with hamburger toggle) + Main Content area.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B (High Density Grid). 4-column for KPI summaries (col-span-1), 3-column for charts (Main chart col-span-2, Secondary col-span-1).
layouts.wizard_layout: Center-aligned multi-step form inside a max-w-3xl card with a top progress bar/stepper. Dynamic fields should animate smoothly.
layouts.table_layout: Full-width Shadcn tables with sticky headers. Add an action column on the right. Search/Filters sit immediately above the table in a flex row.
layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8 for cards). Tight gaps for data items (gap-2 to gap-4).

icons.style: duotone or regular, 20px/24px depending on hierarchy.

toast.usage: Use for 'WhatsApp message copied!', 'Enrollment saved', etc.

charts.customization: MUST use dark-first palette. Grid lines should be very subtle (#1e293b). Tooltips must have dark backgrounds and high contrast text.

whatsapp_summary.design: A visually distinct card styled like a 'receipt' or 'ticket' in the summary step. Mono-spaced font for data fields to mimic plain text output. A prominent 'Copiar para WhatsApp' button.

document_checklist.design: A vertical list of checkboxes. Unchecked: slate-400. Checked: emerald-400 with line-through on the text. Progress indicator (e.g., 2/4 documentos).

motion.page_transitions: Fade-in with slight vertical slide: { opacity: 0, y: 10 } to { opacity: 1, y: 0 }
motion.wizard_transitions: Slide horizontally between steps. Use AnimatePresence for smooth entering/exiting.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons: scale down on click (active:scale-95). Tables: slight bg color change on hover (hover:bg-slate-800/50).

images.description: Dark blue geometric glass architecture, perfect for an abstract corporate SaaS login backdrop. Overlay with a bg-slate-950/80 tint.
Professional avatar placeholder for the fake login user.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against slate-950/900 meets APCA standards. Muted text must be at least slate-400.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., 'nova-matricula-btn', 'wizard-next-btn', 'copy-whatsapp-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React (.jsx or .js) using standard Tailwind CSS classes. No TypeScript (.tsx).
Apply dark mode natively (e.g., set root background to slate-950 and text to slate-50).
Construct the lateral menu (Dashboard, Nova Matrícula, Matrículas, Alunos, Cursos, Campanhas, Relatórios) with Phosphor Icons.
Dashboard must include: KPI cards (today/week/month enrollments, total sold, repasses, gross margin).
Dashboard Charts: Bar chart for 'Cursos mais vendidos', Line chart for evolution, Donut chart for origens/campanhas.

Create the 5-step Wizard for 'Nova Matrícula': 1. Course Category, 2. Student Data (dynamic), 3. Document Checklist (dynamic status), 4. Commercial Info (Lead origin, campaigns), 5. Review & Copy Summary.
Ensure the WhatsApp Summary feature generates a clean text format and utilizes Sonner toast upon successful clipboard copy.
Implement Shadcn components: Cards for layout, Table for listings, Badges for the 7 statuses, Input/Select for forms.
DO NOT add transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. They must have solid slate-900 backgrounds with border-slate-800 to prevent overlap rendering issues.
Implement a Fake Login screen with the provided architectural image as a heavily tinted background, leading into the Dashboard upon clicking 'Entrar'.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use defined color palettes and typography.
Never apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align forms and data.
Use modern button styles (rounded-md, clear hover/active states).
Never use AI emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use sonner for toasts, not raw HTML alerts.
